about_the_game:
Diving Bear is an adventure where you play as a bear diving underwater to explore the ocean’s depths. Collect shells, plants, treasures, and other valuable items from the underwater world. Use your finds to upgrade your gear, allowing you to dive deeper. The deeper you go, the more secrets and hidden places you can discover. Explore the mysterious underwater landscape at your own pace, enjoying the calm and excitement waiting beneath the surface.

Features

  • Relaxed underwater exploration – Swim freely through colorful ocean environments at your own pace.

  • Collect valuable finds – Gather shells, plants, treasures, and rare items scattered across the seabed.

  • Catch fish to grow stronger – Hunt and collect fish to gain experience and level up your abilities.

  • Beware of dangers – Avoid or outmaneuver hostile sea creatures and environmental hazards.

  • Resource-based upgrades – Spend your collected items on improved diving suits, oxygen tanks, and tools.

  • Progressive depth – Upgrade your gear to reach greater depths and uncover hidden locations.
